item.title: 'Jersey Shore' star Snooki says she has cervical cancer
item.description: Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi said Friday that she has cervical cancer.

item.title: Gust of wind blows baby in stroller into Lake Michigan; man helps save child
item.description: A man who jumped in to help shares his story after a gust of wind blew a baby girl in a stroller into Lake Michigan.

item.title: Vehicle restrictions set to go into effect on Pa. and NJ highways due to winter storm
item.description: Local officials are putting vehicle restrictions into place on Sunday as a major nor'easter is set to bring high winds and heavy snow to the area.

item.title: Snow Emergency for Philadelphia to go into effect Sunday afternoon
item.description: A Snow Emergency for the City of Philadelphia will go into effect at 4 p.m. Sunday, Mayor Cherelle Parker said.

item.title: THON 2026 kicks off as thousands of Penn State students dance for a cure
item.description: Thousands of Penn State students are on their feet, committed to helping conquer childhood cancer.

item.title: Snow emergencies declared in Pennsylvania communities due to major winter storm | Check the list
item.description: Snow emergencies have been declared in communities across suburban Pennsylvania due to the major winter storm set to hit Sunday into Monday.

item.title: State of Emergency declared for New Jersey as residents brace for major winter storm
item.description: A state of emergency will go into effect at noon Sunday for all 21 counties in New Jersey, ahead of a nor'easter that is set to bring heavy snow and high winds to the Garden State.

item.title: AccuWeather: Blizzard Warning for parts of New Jersey and Delaware
item.description: AccuWeather is tracking a nor'easter that is expected to bring heavy snow and strong winds to the region.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 missing skiers in deadly California avalanche have been recovered, authorities say
item.description: Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.
